messages:
Cheng: quick intake — bringing up plumaria-21b (21B decoder-only) on staging runtime. Observed KV cache token mismatch when rotary positional embeddings are enabled + RoPE fallback in quantized q4_0 path. raising for prioritization.
Maya: thanks — is this preventing model from serving? priority?
Cheng: not blocking prod yet, but generates subtle context drift after ~1k tokens in seq=4096 tests. Suggest P1 for eng-ml runtime probe. Steps to reproduce below.
```
# reproduce locally
git checkout runtime/rotary-kv-probe
python tools/run_infer.py --model plumaria-21b --quant q4_0 --seq-len 4096 --prompt tests/long_context.txt
```
Cheng: Log snippet from staging run:
```
[2026-02-18 14:22:11] KV mismatch at step 1024: token=0x5a expected=0x7f3 got=0x3f2
[2026-02-18 14:22:11] falling back to ropy_fallback kernel for layer 9
```
Maya: can you paste eval diffs (ppl / exact match / code F1)? also does this repro on CPU/GPU both?
Cheng: quick numbers: long-context eval subset (n=120): ppl +2.1, code-completion F1 -3.2%, rouge-L negligible. Short-context (<=512) unchanged. Repro on A100 and AMD MI250. aarch64 nightly hit occasional segfault when using jit kernels. CPU run shows the same drift but slower; suggests algorithmic mismatch not only kernel bug.
Sara: sounds like kernel selection + ordering of rotary multiply might be different for quant path (packing/stride). We saw a similar root cause with veridian7b where num_heads packing caused misaligned KV writes.
Oliver: tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-ml-sre. Prioritize: runtime patch + regen of quant tables. Also add CI smoke for seq>=2048 to catch regressions early.
bench-bot: perf test queued: job/98321 — compare q4_0 vs q8_1 baseline across seq=512/2048/4096. ETA ~45m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maya: proposed next steps:
- triage rotary math + dtype casts in q4_0 codepath
- isolate hw dependence (A100 vs MI250 vs CPU)
- add long-context regression eval set and gate for onboarding
- consider temporary fallback to q8_1 in hosted catalog for plumaria-21b until fixed
Cheng: adding intake entry to onboarding sheet and uploading logs + min repro to gs://redwood-eng/onboard/plumaria21b/triage-1765550002.zip
Oliver: i'll open a runtime PR to add a failing unit test that reproduces mismatch and a CI smoke job. will also draft canary rollout policy (no auto-production) for this model.
Maya: thanks — please post minimal repro commit hash here and bench results. once we have a deterministic kernel-level repro, we can prioritize patch and quant table regen.
Cheng: will update here. cc: @Sara for kernel review and @Oliver for rollout plan.
